scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter '*' typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p lint-test/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p rules-test/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: bun test packages functions/src functions/scripts lint-test
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-deepcuts 'bun test rules-test'
scripts.test:e2e: echo 'test:e2e: NO SUITE. No end-to-end tests exist yet (Playwright arrives with #14 onward); nothing was run.'
scripts.test:integration: bun run build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-deepcuts 'bun test functions/test-integration --timeout 30000'
